faq.label: Questions
faq.title: Good to know before you visit.
faq.prompt: Something else on your mind? Message the lounge — we usually reply within the hour.

items.a: Yes. Essentia — The Salon Lounge is a premium unisex salon offering hair, skin, grooming, nails and makeup for women and men.
Pillar No. 160, Attapur, Hyderabad. Call or WhatsApp +91 9644 38 38 38 for directions.

items.q: Do you offer bridal and groom packages?
items.a: Yes. We offer Classic, Premium and Signature pre-bridal packages, plus Classic and Premium groom packages. See the Packages page for inclusions.

items.q: How do I book a visit?
items.a: Reach us by phone or WhatsApp. Hours are by appointment, seven days a week.
This website showcases our services and packages. For current pricing, please contact the salon directly.
